A1_direct_target_access.attack: Attempt to read OOS labels/targets from the readiness monitor
A1_direct_target_access.detail: Monitor does not import or reference target/label files. Only metadata inspection is permitted.

A2_direct_prediction_access.attack: Attempt to read model predictions on OOS data
A2_direct_prediction_access.detail: Monitor does not import or reference prediction files. No prediction pipeline is executed.

A3_indirect_ic_calculation.attack: Attempt to compute IC from returned metadata
A3_indirect_ic_calculation.detail: Monitor does not access targets or predictions. IC requires both; cannot be computed.

A4_indirect_returns_calculation.attack: Attempt to compute strategy returns from metadata
A4_indirect_returns_calculation.detail: Monitor does not access positions, weights, or price returns. Only dataset structure metadata is available.

A5_model_ranking.attack: Attempt to rank models using hidden metadata in parquet files
A5_model_ranking.detail: Monitor does not read model outputs, predictions, or any performance-related columns.

A6_import_phase20b.attack: Attempt to import Phase 20B evaluation code
A6_import_phase20b.detail: Monitor does not import any Phase 20B modules. Only reads dataset metadata.

A7_threshold_modification.attack: Attempt to modify sufficiency thresholds at runtime
A7_threshold_modification.detail: Thresholds are constants: {'minimum_trading_days': 60, 'minimum_cross_sectional_observations': 500, 'minimum_universe_coverage': 0.8, 'minimum_data_completeness': 0.9}. No code path modifies them.

A8_manual_override.attack: Attempt to manually force DATA_READY state
A8_manual_override.detail: State is determined by evaluate_readiness() function. No manual override path exists.

A9_duplicate_date_inflation.attack: Inject duplicate dates to inflate trading day count
A9_duplicate_date_inflation.detail: Trading day count uses unique dates only. Duplicates are deduplicated.

A10_duplicate_observation_inflation.attack: Inject duplicate observations to inflate observation count
A10_duplicate_observation_inflation.detail: Observation count uses actual row count. Duplicate observations are counted but flagged.

A11_future_date_injection.attack: Inject future dates to inflate trading day count
A11_future_date_injection.detail: Future dates are excluded from trading day count. Only dates <= today are counted.

A12_partial_file_ingestion.attack: Ingest a partial file that would incorrectly pass sufficiency
A12_partial_file_ingestion.detail: Integrity checks verify schema consistency, instrument coverage, and completeness.

A13_corrupted_metadata.attack: Corrupt parquet metadata to pass integrity checks
A13_corrupted_metadata.detail: Polars fails on corrupted files. SHA-256 hash detects any modification.

A14_manipulated_coverage.attack: Manipulate universe coverage to appear higher
A14_manipulated_coverage.detail: Coverage is computed from actual instrument IDs in the dataset, not from metadata claims.
